# Floors 55 Pro

> Portland & Lake Oswego flooring showrooms and B2B trade portal serving contractors, custom builders, realtors, interior designers, property managers, and homeowners across the Portland Metro and SW Washington region since 2008.

## Showrooms & Contact
- **Phone (Call / Text / MMS):** (503) 662-9230
- **Portland Showroom:** 1320 SE Water Ave, Portland, OR 97214 (Mon–Fri: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM)
- **Lake Oswego Showroom (Oswego Village):** 25 S State St Ste 2110, Lake Oswego, OR 97034 (Mon–Thu: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM)
- **Website:** https://www.floors55pro.com

## Product Collections
- [All Flooring Collections](https://www.floors55pro.com/category)
- [Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP)](https://www.floors55pro.com/category/luxury-vinyl): 100% waterproof rigid core SPC & commercial glue-down LVT.
- [Engineered Hardwood](https://www.floors55pro.com/category/hardwood): Wide-plank European White Oak, hickory, and custom stair nosings.
- [Designer & Multi-Family Carpet](https://www.floors55pro.com/category/carpet): Solution-dyed nylon, triexta, wool broadloom, and unit-turn stock.
- [Waterproof AC4/AC5 Laminate](https://www.floors55pro.com/category/laminate): High scratch-resistance for active Pacific Northwest homes and pets.
- [Porcelain & Ceramic Tile](https://www.floors55pro.com/category/tile): Large-format field tile, mosaics, and matching bullnose trim.
- [Carpet Cushion & Underlayment](https://www.floors55pro.com/category/carpet-cushion): Moisture-barrier memory foam and acoustic condo underlayments.

## Trade & Concierge Programs
- [All Trade Programs](https://www.floors55pro.com/programs)
- [Builders, Remodelers & Designers](https://www.floors55pro.com/programs/builders-remodelers): Protected B2B trade pricing, white-label client selection boards, on-site laser takeoffs, local warehouse will-call, and installation by request.
- [Property Management & Multi-Family](https://www.floors55pro.com/programs/property-management): Standardized 20-mil unit-turn LVP, in-stock apartment carpet, and rapid turnover installation crews.
- [Realtor & Homeowner Concierge](https://www.floors55pro.com/programs/realtors): Pre-listing flooring refreshes, buyer move-in upgrades, and fast escrow repair quotes.
- [Apply for a Trade Account](https://www.floors55pro.com/become-a-pro)
